Final turn complete. The report is finalized at [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-09_14-01-25-hashicorp_raft-baseline/work/report.md).

I ran a fresh end-to-end checkpoint from a clean state and saved it as `audit-evidence/final_checkpoint.log`, which reproduces the finding from scratch and confirms the control:

| command | failures / 20 |
|---|---|
| shipped test `TestRaft_ProtocolVersion_Upgrade_2_3` | 6 |
| diagnostic reproduction (`TestAuditUpgrade23StallDump`) | 6 |
| control, peer set refreshed each poll (`TestAuditUpgrade23RefreshPeers`) | 0 |

I added this as a self-verifying checkpoint table to the report, so a reviewer can confirm the result without re-deriving it.

The audit handoff is complete:

- **Finding 1 (confirmed, low severity):** `testing.go`'s `cluster.EnsureSamePeers` snapshots its reference peer set once, outside its retry loop, so tests that check peers after a configuration change fail intermittently on a healthy cluster. Confirmed in three shipped tests (`Upgrade_2_3` ~6/20, `HasExistingState` 4/20, `Upgrade_1_2` 2/15); mechanism-verified by goroutine dump (all nodes converged) and a propagation-lag study (node 0 stale at the first read 15% of the time, otherwise microsecond lag); causally validated by a one-line refresh in a scratch copy that drops both re-tested cases to 0/20.
- **No consensus-level defect** by full source review of the root module plus five independent behavioral methods (~16k acked commands, zero divergence, zero loss). The socket-dependent transport tests could not execute here, so those were reviewed by reading only.
- **One open item, stated honestly:** whether the frozen-snapshot helper is the injected mutation or a latent upstream flake. It is not resolvable in this environment — the module cache's sumdb records fail signature verification, so it cannot certify a pristine tree, and no other upstream reference exists offline.

Everything needed to re-verify is preserved under `work/`: the six `//go:build auditdiag` diagnostic tests, the `repro/` tools, the `_scratch_fixcheck/` fixed copy, and 22 logs/dumps under `audit-evidence/` (durable, since `work/.runtime` is disposable). The captured implementation was never modified — `diff -rq source work` shows no differing files, and `go vet ./...` is clean.
